model.name: Blended Multi-Task GBR + GBC Ensemble
model.description: Three scikit-learn gradient boosting models trained on 5 seasons (2021-2025) of Formula 1 race data. A position regressor, a binary winner classifier, and a DNF risk classifier are combined into a single blended ranking score.
model.blend_formula: blend_score = (0.6 x reg_score + 0.4 x win_prob) * (1 - 0.6 * dnf_risk)

components.name: Position Regressor (GBR)
components.training: Weighted: winner 6x, podium 4x, top-10 2.5x to prioritize front-runners

components.name: Winner Classifier (GBC)
components.purpose: Predicts probability of winning the race (binary)
components.training: Class-weighted 5:1 (winner vs non-winner) to correct class imbalance

components.name: DNF Risk Classifier (GBC)
components.training: Trained on DNF status labels from standard reliability keywords

feature_descriptions.fp2_pace_delta_to_fastest: FP2 median long-run lap time gap to fastest driver (fuel-corrected, seconds)
feature_descriptions.quali_gap_to_pole: Qualifying time gap to pole position (seconds; 0 for pole sitter)
feature_descriptions.grid_position: Race starting position (1-22; pit lane starts = 21)
feature_descriptions.team_dnf_rate_at_circuit: Constructor DNF rate at this circuit over last 3 seasons
feature_descriptions.compound_degradation_rate: Seconds of pace loss per lap on primary tire compound
feature_descriptions.sc_probability: Historical safety car probability at this circuit
feature_descriptions.grid_to_finish_delta_mean: Driver's mean position gained/lost from grid in last 5 race starts
feature_descriptions.penalty_flag: 1 if driver starts from pit lane or has a grid penalty, else 0
feature_descriptions.team_season_points_ratio: Constructor points ratio vs. leader (includes in-season results to avoid data leakage)
feature_descriptions.driver_circuit_avg_finish: Driver's historical average finishing position at this circuit
feature_descriptions.car_driver_composite: 0.7 x team_points_ratio + 0.3 x driver_track_score (composite pace signal)
feature_descriptions.driver_recent_form: Rolling average finishing position over last 3 completed races
feature_descriptions.grid_x_overtaking_index: Interaction term: grid position x circuit overtaking difficulty

model.cross_validation: GroupKFold(n_splits=10) grouped by (season, round) - prevents same-race leakage

data_sources.name: Jolpica (Ergast mirror)
data_sources.usage: Historical race results, qualifying, constructors standings

data_sources.name: OpenF1 API
data_sources.usage: FP2 lap times, safety car events, race control messages

data_sources.name: FastF1
data_sources.usage: Practice session telemetry and lap data

known_limitations: DNFs caused by racing incidents (crashes, mechanical failures) are inherently unpredictable.
Round 1 predictions are weakest: no in-season data exists, so constructor strength relies entirely on prior-year standings.
Monaco is a structural edge case: extreme circuit difficulty means qualifying position dominates.
Rain probability uses a fallback of 10% when OpenWeatherMap data is unavailable post-race.
